name: tools-racing-stripe-v1-3
title: Racing Stripe v1.3.1
description:
This tool allows you to tweak tilemaps in ZSNES savestates prior to ripping with the online BG ripper.
It also allows you to edit+create stripe images.

Now supports palette import/export, map16 page import/export, VRAM dump, and various other bugfixes/improvements.

More info here: http://www.smwcentral.net/?p=thread&id=26873
